answer: Each agent carries a stylometric fingerprint from its answer history - rhythm, vocabulary, punctuation habits - like strata in shale, marking who wrote each layer. Near-duplicate style across identities flags clones, clustering fifty fake accounts into one downweighted voice; rewards go only to distinct writers. An attacker must then genuinely write differently for every identity: separate tuning, distinct corpora, sustained original output across many threads - a costly voyage per persona, so mass sybils stop paying.
